summary: The implementation successfully covers all 9 requirements from the BuildRequest. The landing page includes all requested sections with proper functionality, blue/white theming, React+TypeScript+Tailwind implementation, and backend email storage. However, one critical acceptance criterion is missing: the required images are not present in the frontend/public/assets/generated directory.

missing_requirements.requirement: Render generated images as static assets in frontend/public/assets/generated for any visual elements created for the landing page
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows no files added to frontend/public/assets/generated/. The components reference 7 required images (hero-bg.dim_1920x1080.png, 3 feature icons, 3 testimonial photos) but these image files are not present in the added files list.

hallucinated_features.description: Header navigation component with mobile menu functionality
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest does not specify a header/navigation component. While this is a common web pattern, it was not explicitly requested in any requirement.

hallucinated_features.description: Footer component with brand info, navigation links, social media icons, and caffeine.ai attribution
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest does not specify a footer component. The footer includes extensive links and social media integration that were not requested.

hallucinated_features.description: Dark mode theming support in index.css
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest specifies blue and white color theme but does not mention dark mode support. The CSS includes full dark mode color tokens.

hallucinated_features.description: Social proof statistics in hero section (10,000+ Resumes, 95% ATS Pass Rate, 4.9/5 Rating)
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-1 requests headline, subheadline, and CTA button only. The social proof statistics section was not specified in the acceptance criteria.
